- Installing solar panels on all public buildings by 2027
- Creating three new community gardens in underserved neighborhoods
- Implementing a city-wide composting program with curbside pickup

### Public Safety and Community Relations

- Establishing neighborhood liaison officer programs in every district
- Funding community violence intervention programs
- Increasing mental health crisis response teams to work alongside traditional emergency services
- Creating youth engagement programs focused on conflict resolution and leadership

### Education and Youth Services
We must invest in our children's future by:
- Extending after-school program hours to 6 PM to support working families
- Building two new recreation centers in areas currently lacking facilities
- Providing free tutoring services at public libraries
